lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth, a single piano line, count-in]
Hana, dul, set

[Verse 1: first voice, low and tense]
I kept it folded in my sleeve
The part of me I couldn't leave
Smiled on cue and learned the steps
Saved the real one for what's left

[Pre-Chorus: second voice, climbing, drums build]
But the stage lights don't lie
And I'm tired of the disguise
One more breath, then I

[Chorus: all three voices, huge, very high top line]
I'm gonna sing it louder than my secret
Turn it up until I believe it
No more shadow, no more half
This is my voice and I'm taking it back
Higher, higher
Watch me rise
Louder than my secret tonight

[Verse 2: third voice, half rapped, confident]
Used to count the exits, used to check the room
Used to make me smaller than the afternoon
Now I take the space and I take the mic
Every scar's a sequin in the right light

[Pre-Chorus: second voice, climbing, drums build]
And the stage lights don't lie
I was never the disguise
One more breath, then I

[Chorus: all three voices, huge, very high top line]
I'm gonna sing it louder than my secret
Turn it up until I believe it
No more shadow, no more half
This is my voice and I'm taking it back
Higher, higher
Watch me rise
Louder than my secret tonight

[Bridge: beat drops, first voice alone, soft]
If you're hiding too
I'll sing it for the both of us
Hana, dul, set

[Final Chorus: key lifts, everything, highest note held]
I'm gonna sing it louder than my secret
Turn it up until I believe it
No more shadow, no more half
This is my voice and I'm taking it back
Higher, higher
Watch me rise
Louder than my secret tonight

[Outro: voices in harmony, one held chord]
Louder
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 123 BPM, 4/4, D major, lifting a step for the final chorus. Tense, then soaring. A film finale in three minutes.

VOICE: Three women. The first has a clear, emotional voice and carries the low verse and the bridge. The second has a bright, strong belt and takes the climbing pre-chorus. The third half raps the second verse with attitude. Together they sing the chorus, with one voice on a top line that sits at the upper limit of a soprano belt, and a held highest note in the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Pulsing synthesiser chords. A driving dance-pop beat with a strong kick and layered claps. A deep, punchy synth bass. Piano. Bright synth brass stabs. A string section and choir pad in the final chorus. Risers and impacts between sections.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pulse, piano and a counted 'one, two, three' in Korean. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:29 Pre-chorus. 0:41 Chorus 1. 1:08 Verse 2. 1:27 Pre-chorus. 1:39 Chorus 2. 2:06 Bridge, the beat drops and one voice sings softly. 2:22 A riser and the key lift into the final chorus with the highest held note. 2:52 Outro, three-part harmony on one word and a held chord at 3:05.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2020s K-pop for the screen: huge, glossy and precise, every hit exaggerated, vocals stacked and bright, a very wide stereo image.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The leap to the top note on the first line of the chorus at 0:41.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The bridge turns outward: if you are hiding too, I will sing it for both of us. That is what a parent in the front seat hears in a song the back seat is shouting.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Concealment, resolve, flight, solidarity.
